narrative_shape: Edit-heavy decode-side fixes, then a short pytest wait. By turn 75 there are 18 edits across walk, parcel metrics, and census/overlay tools, and several of those files are described as already complete. Two more edits land by turn 83. Turns 99–103 park on a pytest monitor ("I'll just wait and poll"). Edit count stops at 20. The run ends at T=116, so the wait is the close of the prefix and is not shown failing or recovering.

rationale: The early window is an edit burst that ends in a pytest wait. The wait is inside ≤120 and is short. It is not yet a stalled trajectory, and the rereads match files under edit.
